46/S0.subgoal: Explain the formulation of research questions and the identification of variables in an empirical study.

46/S1.subgoal: Explain how to select a representative user profile for an empirical study.

46/S2.subgoal: Explain how to determine the number of participants and identify representative tasks for an empirical study.

46/S3.subgoal: Explain task assignment methods, including within-subject and between-subject designs and how to mitigate the practice effect.

46/S4.subgoal: Explain the necessity of statistical significance when analyzing empirical data.

46/S5.subgoal: Illustrate how to use statistical significance to determine if a relative difference is reliable.

46/S6.subgoal: Identify appropriate parametric and non-parametric statistical tests based on experimental design and data types.

46/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
